Collection-specific filtering and keyword search for targeted competitor benchmarking
Clean structured output in JSON, CSV, Parquet, or live Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool responses
Ready for automated price-drop webhooks and restock alerts in n8n and Make

E-commerce catalog ingestion for AI shopping assistants and RAG vector databases
Inventory stockout / restock tracking and wholesale product research

Choose thorlan04/eu-b2b-compliance-ai-auditor if you want a complete all-in-one check combining French SIREN/SIRET validation, official EU VIES VAT verification, live website GDPR compliance (cookies, privacy policy, legal notices), European Accessibility Act (EAA 2025 / WCAG 2.1 AA) auditing, and an llms.txt AI-Readiness score on a Pay-Per-Event model.
